column1: # WSDL 1.1 and 2.0 counters (.wsdl): the counters of xml-facts, its [ignore] line included (an
# embedded XML Schema counts there, under "XSD type definitions"), then one per WSDL element, with any
# prefix or none but that of a binding extension (soap, soap12, http, mime, wsoap, whttp, jms), so
# the soap:binding and soap:operation of a binding count only under "SOAP bindings". "operations"
# counts the <operation> of a portType or an interface, not that of a binding, which holds a
# soap:operation, soap12:operation or http:operation (WSDL 1.1) or names its operation with ref
# (WSDL 2.0); a binding's operation without either counts again. EnterpriseXmlFactPatternsTest pins every case;
# ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every pattern reads linearly.
